Definition
[Rotation fields] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0451 ↗ def:chow-ii-vertical-frame-fields 1. appf:F.19\group Orthonormal Frame Bundle

Define the vertical rotation fields \[ \rho _{ab}=g_{ac}\Lambda ^c_b-g_{bc}\Lambda ^c_a. \] On $\mathcal O\mathcal M$, this is $\rho _{ab}=\Lambda ^a_b-\Lambda ^b_a$ and $\rho _{ba}=-\rho _{ab}$.
